text: psychnet() estimates psychometric network cross-sectional estimators, selected method. psychometric network represents variables, questionnaire items, symptoms behaviours, nodes conditional marginal associations edges. estimators differ edge means: partial-correlation networks describe association two variables controlling others, regularized networks retain associations data support, Ising mixed graphical models apply idea binary mixed data. Besides method, arguments select variables (vars), estimate one network per group (group), scale variable within persons first (within), treat data event log (actor, action, session, time), converted action frequencies per occasion network estimated. psychnet() returns fitted network; group, one network per group, event data pair within-actor -actor networks. method can also called directly, exposes full set options. Panel data measured waves modelled panel_gvar(), psychnet() route. method-specific pages describe model: ebic_glasso(), ggm_modselect(), huge_network(), tmfg_network(), logo_network(), relimp_network(), cor_network(), pcor_network(), ising_fit(), ising_sampler() mgm_fit().

code: set.seed(1) x <- matrix(stats::rnorm(200 * 5), 200, 5) colnames(x) <- c("joy", "fear", "calm", "anger", "trust") psychnet(x, method = "glasso") #> <psychnet> glasso network #>   nodes: 5   edges: 0   (undirected) #>   lambda: 0.06852   gamma: 0.5 #>   optimality (KKT residual): 1.39e-17 psychnet(x, method = "pcor", vars = joy:anger)     # name range #> <psychnet> pcor network #>   nodes: 4   edges: 6   (undirected) psychnet(x, method = "glasso", vars = 1:3)         # index range #> <psychnet> glasso network #>   nodes: 3   edges: 0   (undirected) #>   lambda: 0.06817   gamma: 0.5 #>   optimality (KKT residual): 0.00e+00 psychnet(x, method = "EBICglasso")                 # qgraph alias, same result #> <psychnet> glasso network #>   nodes: 5   edges: 0   (undirected) #>   lambda: 0.06852   gamma: 0.5 #>   optimality (KKT residual): 1.39e-17  ev <- data.frame(   Actor  = rep(paste0("s", 1:30), each = 20),   Action = sample(c("read", "quiz", "note", "watch"), 600, replace = TRUE)) psychnet(ev, actor = "Actor", action = "Action")   # event data, auto-detected #> <psychnet> glasso network #>   nodes: 4   edges: 6   (undirected) #>   lambda: 0.004501   gamma: 0.5 #>   optimality (KKT residual): 1.07e-09  d <- data.frame(g = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 100),                 matrix(stats::rnorm(200 * 4), 200, 4,                        dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("V", 1:4)))) psychnet(d, method = "glasso", group = "g")         # one network per level #> <psychnet_group> 2 networks by g (method: glasso) #>  group nodes edges   n #>      A     4     0 100 #>      B     4     0 100  # Within-person networks, one per week, scaled within each student over all # four weeks; compare two weeks (paired by student automatically). nets <- psychnet(srl_panel, vars = efficacy:anxiety, group = "week",                  within = "student") nets #> <psychnet_group> 4 networks by week (method: glasso) #>  group nodes edges   n #>      1     5     6 100 #>      2     5     6 100 #>      3     5     7 100 #>      4     5     7 100 set.seed(1) net_compare(nets, c(1, 4), iter = 3)  # iter >= 1000 in practice #> Network Comparison Test: 1 vs 4 #> 3 permutations, paired groups, n = 100 and 100 #>  #>   Test                  Statistic       p #>   M  network structure      0.084   1.000  #>   S  global strength        0.006   1.000  #>        1 1.516 vs 4 1.510 #>   E  edges differing      0 of 10 #>  #>   Edges, largest difference first #>   Edge                       1       4  |diff|       p #>   planning - effort      0.115   0.199   0.084   0.250  #>   effort - enjoyment     0.382   0.314   0.068   0.750  #>   efficacy - anxiety     0.000   0.064   0.064   0.250  #>   efficacy - planning    0.503   0.440   0.063   1.000  #>   efficacy - effort      0.312   0.358   0.046   1.000  #>   planning - enjoyment   0.165   0.125   0.040   0.500  #>   efficacy - enjoyment   0.039   0.011   0.029   1.000  #>   effort - anxiety       0.000   0.000   0.000   1.000  #>   enjoyment - anxiety    0.000   0.000   0.000   1.000  #>   planning - anxiety     0.000   0.000   0.000   1.000  #>  #>   * p < 0.05

Ignored methods. .data.frame(), table return: "edges" (default) one row per estimated edge three networks, standard error, p-value 95% Wald interval; autoregressive effects temporal rows == . "parameters" every model parameter, including means, scale parameters edges fixed zero. "fit" one row fit indices. "diagnostics" one row: number persons waves, certificate (score), whether solution boundary, whether standard errors available, many optimizer starts reached best optimum. starts full model, penalized solution selected penalty select = "ebic", refit refit = TRUE. "variance" one row per variable: model-implied -person variance, stationary within-person variance, -person share total (intraclass correlation). "covariance" one row per entry lower triangle, diagonal included, innovation (contemporaneous) -person covariance matrices, data scale. "path" select = "ebic": one row per penalty value EBIC path. include_zero = "edges": also return edges fixed zero pruning penalty. Default FALSE. edge_labels plot(): print edge's weight . Default TRUE.
